ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Guiding Star: Ted Knight’s strong moral compass allows him to lead by example—not just the citizens of Opal City, but his fellow heroes and those who follow him as Starman. Guilt: The guilt Ted Knight felt over his part in inventing the atomic bomb led to him spending part of the 1950s in a sanitarium. Ever since, the possible repercussions of his inventions and actions weigh heavily on him, sometimes leading him to do nothing at all. aLLI e S Starman’s greatest allies have always been his friends in the Justice Society and the All-Star Squadron, but he was par - ticularly close to his cousin, the first Phantom Lady, and Black Canary, with whom he had a brief affair. Years later he worked closely with his sons when they carried on the legacy of Star- man, as well as other heroes who protected Opal City.
